                    ### Question
                    Which of the following glomerulopathies is the most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Membranous glomerulonephritis.
opb. Segmental focal glomerulosclerosis.
opc. Diabetic nephropathy.
opd. Kidney Amyloidosis

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Membranous glomerulonephritis is the most frequent cause of nephrotic syndrome in the elderly, with diabetic nephropathy also being a common cause. Kidney amyloidosis is a less common cause in this age group. Evidence supports the role of diabetic nephropathy in causing nephrotic syndrome.
